newsitem.title: UK: Toad leaps higher on marketing deal appeal.
newsitem.headline: Toad leaps higher on marketing deal appeal.

text.p: Shares in British car security group Toad Plc leapt 7-1/2p, or 18 percent, to 48-1/2p on Friday after Thursday's news that broadcaster, Noel Edmonds, was to market the group's products, market makers said.
"It's a funny old beast with a chequered past and it's a story private investors would see in the paper and like. That's what's driving the price," said a market maker.
Toad shares crashed 32 percent on February 10 after chief executive, Charles Parker, resigned and the company issued a sales warning.
The stock put on 1-1/2p on Thursday.
